title: Seat Booking — visual/manual rubric
setup: npm install; npm run dev. Open TWO browser windows.

items.criterion: Seat map renders the seeded grid with three visually distinct states (available / held / booked), distinguishable at a glance.
Holding seats shows a countdown that visibly reflects the hold's remaining TTL.
Realtime: holds/confirms/releases made in window A change seat colors in window B without reload.
Conflict UX: when a hold fails (409), the UI indicates WHICH seats were taken and refreshes the map.
Expiry: after the TTL elapses, held seats visibly return to available in both windows without any manual action.
